ruleDefinitions.name: Persistence Via New SIP Provider
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an attacker register a new SIP provider for persistence and defense evasion Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Cryptography\\\\Providers\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Cryptography\\\\OID\\\\EncodingType.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Cryptography\\\\Providers\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Cryptography\\\\OID\\\\EncodingType.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Dll.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\$DLL.*"))) AND  NOT ((Details = "WINTRUST\.DLL" OR Details = "mso\.dll") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CryptSIPDll.*") AND Details = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\PsfSip\.dll"))
